+def _route(data, coupon_rule, minimum_duration):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    start = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bits.get(start, 0)
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    initial = (start, initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {initial: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], start, initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, spent = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, spent)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if (node == data["target"] and mask == full and
+                (coupon_rule == "at_most" or spent == coupons)):
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], spent)]
+            if spent < coupons:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((duration, spent + 1))
+            for duration, next_spent in options:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bits.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_spent)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, next_node, next_mask, next_spent))
+    return {"arrival": None}

+def _jobs(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for subset in combinations(options, k):
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
